skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Laminar Flow
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Laminar Flow. Clothes Underflow wore to the theater in Ægir. Lightweight armor and a tailored skirt come together to form a balance between comfort and defense.
skins.quote: The curtain falls without a single mistake during the performance. Even without a pen, Underflow is able to freely analyze and connect all the details. She enjoyed this holistic work, and gives it her sincere admiration.
